decision: Longer limits score 575/960 (59.90%), tying the retained best submission. They change 21 of 1,919 programs, but 5 of the 23 regenerated rows still lack EOS after the larger budget. Keep the existing inference notebook and checkpoint: this test shows no public score gain. Public rank is 9/16 at 15:25 (+03:00). No further extension is justified by this result.
compute: The CPU driver took 44.31 seconds, including 19.72 seconds regenerating 23 rows; this excludes allocation, authentication and package setup. No GPU was allocated and no training was performed. A late monitoring request briefly reconnected a new CPU runtime after automatic release; that runtime was manually released, and Manage Sessions showed no active sessions. Incremental CPU timing is not a full 1,919-row inference measurement. T4 timing remains deferred and unverified.
